intentionally-changed.reason: CRW-1148 fixed the oracle's help handling: --help, -h and help in any argument position of any config action print the usage and exit 0 before anything is read or written (the oracle looked for help only in the action position, so set and unset treated it as an id or a value and list listed the keys). Claim handover from CRW-348.

set.steps/0/stdout:
Usage:
  crw install config list                          managed keys, their live values and side effects
  crw install config get <table.key>
  crw install config set <table.key> <true|false>
  crw install config unset <table.key>             restore the value from before crw set it
  crw pabcd config interview [off|new-unit|always]

Only whitelisted keys can be set; 'config list' shows them. Installation writes just the
ones marked auto-enable in managed-keys.ts, records the pre-install value, and 'crw install features
disable' restores it; the rest stay an explicit choice. (Separate vocabulary: the
[features] flags crw needs to run ARE turned on by install and by SessionStart
self-heal; see crw doctor's `features` check.)
